recommendation: Keep the commit. It fixes the remaining semantic documentation problem for the seed while preserving the current status/adherence/effective model; no new medication-use status codes should be added unless Pharmacy makes a later contrary decision.
issue_request: FHIR-32858 was a Published Pharmacy issue, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking whether MedicationUsage needed expanded status capability because R5 status had become record status and some R4 medication-use status scenarios seemed unsupported.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-32858 was found. Earlier Pharmacy changes introduced the status/adherence model: FHIR-19468/FHIR-19470/FHIR-28593 moved taking/not-taking representation to adherence, FHIR-32060 changed status to recorded, entered-in-error, and draft, and FHIR-38682 later renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement. The prior edit that added adherence.reason carried over stale statusReason wording.
additional_context: FHIR-31972 and FHIR-31879 were duplicate concerns in the same status-scope family. FHIR-39271 later confirmed that status is recording status and adherence carries taking/not-taking meaning; FHIR-39329 and FHIR-39333 clarified and expanded adherence, including on-hold and stopped not-taking cases. Confluence Pharmacy minutes and the Zulip R5 MedicationUsage status/adherence thread support that interpretation.
reconciliation: Updated source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml for MedicationStatement.adherence.reason, replacing stale guidance about exception statuses and reasonCode with text explaining use, non-use, stopped use, and taking differently than directed, while pointing statement-level rationale to MedicationStatement.reason.
source_changes: source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml: clarified MedicationStatement.adherence.reason short, definition, and comment to describe use, non-use, stopped use, and taking differently than directed, and to reference MedicationStatement.reason instead of the old reasonCode model.

related_jiras.note: Changed MedicationUsage.status to recorded, entered-in-error, and draft, establishing status as record status.
Duplicate clarification issue about MedicationUsage status codes cited by the seed.
Duplicate concern about statusReason after the status-scope change; it explains the stale wording but was not independently decided.
Later published issue confirmed status is recording status and adherence carries taking/not-taking meaning; it was already represented on the combined branch.
Later clarified the MedicationStatement.adherence element for taking or not-taking regardless of prescription/instruction.
Later expanded the example adherence codes with on-hold and stopped descendants.
